synthesis: DEV-2651 already extracted the three ratio numerators into RatioAgainstUniqueScans and left them pinned to UTC so they would zip against UTC (claims) or date-grained (repo_date) denominators. This ticket moves only those numerators onto the viewer's clock by passing ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::safeTimezone() into the existing handle()/handleRange() path, which already does toUtcDatetime() and keeps WHERE on raw UTC. Claims ts stays UTC: Eric has not signed, and shifting it would move the historical claims funnel off Brek's Repo Report. repo_date cannot be shifted. The ratio therefore stays a documented quotient of two clocks. Cache keys that already carry :tz= pick up the new zone automatically; RecoveryTotalsBatchQuery::sharedMonthCacheKey() and the UTC claims monthly keys must not grow a :tz= segment.

ac5.reconciliation_impact: Historical claims-funnel figures stay bucketed on UTC via toDate(fromUnixTimestamp(be.ts), 'UTC'). Deferring keeps them on the same clock as Brek's Repo Report. Shipping a viewer-zone shift without Eric would move every historical claims figure off that reconciliation. UniqueLprCaseClaims (deduped) and LprRepossessions (db_repos, which buckets the same be.ts) both stay UTC. The ratio numerators may move; these denominators do not.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC-1 Ratio numerators bucket and window in the viewer timezone via safeTimezone() + toUtcDatetime(); WHERE still filters raw UTC.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Callers pass the sanitised zone into ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::handle() and handleRange(), which already convert bounds and group the monthly series in that zone. Do not add a second conversion.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC-2 Invalid or legacy users.dti (CST, PST, +05:00) falls back to UTC and the card renders; it never throws.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Those three construct a DateTimeZone and are absent from the allowlist, so safeTimezone() returns UTC. Callers must sanitise before now(tz:). A zone DateTimeZone rejects (US/Central on this PHP) also returns UTC from in_array and must not be constructed first.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC-3 Cache keys that depend on timezone include :tz=; RecoveryTotalsBatchQuery::sharedMonthCacheKey() is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.reason: sharedMonthCacheKey() and sharedRangeCacheKey() on ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery already include :tz=. Passing the viewer zone forks those keys. The recovery month key must stay timezone-free. The UTC claims monthly key must not gain :tz= while AC5 is deferred.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC-4 Remaining mixed-clock seams (repo_date denominators, and claims denominators left on UTC) are documented in the class docblocks.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Do not relabel the headline axis onto the numerator clock. That would fake agreement. Document the quotient.

questions.question: Does claims ts ship in this ticket?
questions.answer: Defer. Numerators ship. UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery and LprRepossessionsQuery keep toDate(fromUnixTimestamp(be.ts), 'UTC').
questions.impact: Historical claims funnel figures stay on UTC bucketing. They remain reconcilable to Brek's Repo Report. A viewer-zone claims shift would move every historical figure off that reconciliation. The ratio on UniqueLprCaseClaims and LprRepossessions is then a viewer-local unique-scans numerator over a UTC claims denominator until Eric signs.

questions.question: When the numerator moves and the denominator cannot, which clock do the chart labels follow?
questions.answer: The headline (denominator) clock. Labels already co-vary with getMonthlyData() on purpose. The numerator is indexed as 'N months before now' in the viewer zone and zipped positionally. The docblock says the two clocks disagree near a boundary. Do not convert repo_date and do not relabel UTC claims months as if they were local.
